insight: This prospect valued hands-on learning, wanted control, and had existing campaign and landing-page experience, but questioned the accelerator’s format and ongoing agency costs. He asked about performance-based support, which Whitney said WIA did not offer; he considered a one-time audit more realistic but did not confirm a purchase.
strategic_use: Use this as sales and audience intelligence when clarifying service fit: a capable owner may want diagnosis and practical conversation before committing to a broader educational or ongoing support model. Avoid treating the proposed audit as a purchase, a result, or evidence of current pricing.
research_questions: Did the prospect book or receive the proposed audit?
What format or support, if any, addressed his stated preference for hands-on learning?
Were the audit scope and fee application to a later accelerator confirmed as described?
